alloc.f_unlinked_hint: Only units that don't belong to any line of the lot.
alloc.spec_values_hint: One or more values separated by commas
alloc.mh_unit_amount: Every unit gets exactly this amount.
alloc.mh_group_total: This amount is split equally among the units of the group.
alloc.mh_percent: This percent of the total amount is split equally among the units of the group.
alloc.mh_weight: What is left is split by weight: a unit with weight 2 gets twice as much as one with weight 1.
alloc.mh_by_list: What is left is split by list price: the more expensive unit gets more.
alloc.mh_by_cost: What is left is split by the cost each unit already has.
alloc.rule_unused: This rule doesn't match any unit right now.
alloc.no_rules_cost: No rules: the cost is split equally among all units (per the base below). Add rules to give more or less cost to certain units.
alloc.no_rules_price: No rules: the amount is split per the base below. Add rules to fix the price of certain units and split the rest.
alloc.base: What no rule claims is split…
alloc.base_hint: The rules' fixed amounts are applied first; what is left is split among units without a rule and those with weight-based rules.

costs.stale_msg: The lot's data (counts, units or costs) changed since the last distribution.
costs.none_msg: The cost hasn't been distributed among the units yet. Adjust the amounts and rules, check the result and press “Save and distribute”.
costs.none_view_msg: This lot's cost hasn't been distributed among its units yet.
costs.merchandise_hint: What was paid to the supplier for the equipment.
costs.extra_needs_label: Costs without a description are ignored.
costs.distribute_hint: If “Distribute” is unchecked, the cost counts toward the lot total but isn't added to the units' cost.
costs.plan_title: How it is split among the units
costs.plan_intro: Rules are checked in order: each group of units falls under the first rule that matches it. What no rule fixes is split according to the base.
costs.qty_basis_hint: How many units each line's cost is calculated for.
costs.qb_auto: What was counted (or expected if not counted yet)
costs.auto_hint: When counts, units or costs change, the distribution updates by itself.
costs.no_targets: This lot has no lines or units
costs.no_targets_hint: Add lines to the lot to distribute its cost.
costs.fixed_hint: Sold units or units with a hand-set cost keep their cost.
costs.pin_hint: Fix this group's cost with a new rule
costs.r_frozen: Already assigned (sold units or fixed cost)
costs.w_over_allocated: The rules assign {{amount}} too much: there isn't enough for the other units.
costs.w_unallocated: {{amount}} is left to distribute and there are no units to assign it to.
costs.w_empty_group: “{{name}}” claims units that don't exist yet: its amount can't be distributed.
costs.stats: {{withCost}} of {{units}} registered units have a cost · {{manual}} set by hand.
costs.clear_msg: The lot's units will have no cost (hand-set costs are kept). You can distribute again whenever you want.
costs.tpl_intro: Save this lot's rules to reuse them in other lots.

pricing.title: List prices
pricing.subtitle: Rules to calculate each unit's price from its cost, type, grade and characteristics.
pricing.auto_hint: When a unit finishes testing, changes its data or its cost changes, it gets the price these rules give. Hand-set prices are never touched (unless you ask).
pricing.rules_intro: They are checked in order: each unit gets the price of the first rule that matches it.
pricing.no_rules: No rules yet. Add one, for example: “all laptops = cost + 30%, ending in .99”.
pricing.prh_fixed: All units in the rule are priced at this amount.
pricing.prh_margin_pct: Price = cost ÷ (1 − %). E.g. cost 100 with 30% margin → 142.86.
pricing.apply_intro: Calculate the price of units already in inventory using the rules above.
pricing.scope_unsold: All that are neither sold nor reserved
pricing.overwrite_hint: By default, prices someone typed by hand are respected.
pricing.preview_result: {{changed}} of {{considered}} units would change price ({{manual}} hand-set are respected).
pricing.recalc_msg: The rules are saved and the prices of units without a hand-set price are updated.
pricing.recalc_msg_overwrite: The rules are saved and ALL prices are replaced, including hand-set ones.
pricing.cm_pct: Raise or lower by a percentage
pricing.cm_plan: Go back to the lot distribution
pricing.v_signed_hint: Use a negative number to lower it.
pricing.cost_plan_hint: The units get the cost they are due according to the lot distribution again.
pricing.cost_manual_hint: The cost is set by hand: the lot distribution respects it and splits the rest among the other units.
pricing.pm_pct: Raise or lower by a percentage
pricing.pm_margin: Calculate with a margin over cost
pricing.pm_set_hint: The price is set by hand and the rules won't change it.
pricing.pm_pct_hint: Applied on the current list price (units without a price are skipped).
pricing.pm_add_hint: Added to the current list price (units without a price are skipped).
pricing.pm_margin_hint: Price = cost ÷ (1 − margin). Units without a cost are skipped.
pricing.pm_rules_hint: It is calculated again with the price rules.
pricing.pm_clear_hint: The unit is left without a list price.
pricing.price_skipped: ({{count}} skipped for lacking a price or cost)
pricing.missing_cost: {{count}} unit(s) have no cost: the profit is incomplete.
pricing.charges_not_profit: Charges (shipping, taxes) aren't counted as profit; discounts are subtracted.
pricing.adj_intro: Add a discount or a charge (shipping, taxes…) to the order total, as a percentage of the subtotal or as an amount.
pricing.plan_title: Split a total price among the units
pricing.plan_intro: Type how much the customer pays and the system splits that amount among the order's units following the rules. The lines add up to exactly that amount.
pricing.plan_t_total: The order's final total (with discounts and charges)
pricing.plan_selected_hint: The amount is what the selected units will add up to.
pricing.list_intro: {{count}} unit(s) in the order have a list price. You can copy it to the order.
pricing.list_missing: Copy to the {{count}} without a price
pricing.quick_hint: If left empty, each unit's list price is used.
